impact_on_conclusions: Inflates volume and every count-based rate; double-counts those members in repeat-contact logic (a duplicate looks like a same-day repeat).
decision: Verified all copies identical on every column (A2); kept one copy per Interaction_ID.

impact_on_conclusions: Splits Phone into two groups; Phone volume, wait and rates would be understated in any channel cut.
decision: Mapped case-insensitively to a controlled list; unknown values become UNMAPPED and fail a control test.

impact_on_conclusions: Treating blank as 0 would understate average wait.
decision: Kept as NULL; excluded from wait averages only (row still counts in volume and outcome rates). Coverage shown with the KPI.

issue: Satisfaction missing for most interactions (survey non-response)
impact_on_conclusions: Only ~28% respond; unresolved outcomes score much lower, so the average reflects who responded, not all members. Not comparable to a 4.2 target without knowing survey method.
decision: Kept NULL = no response. Report avg score AND response rate AND n together; never impute.

impact_on_conclusions: Abandoned contacts have no agent work, so including them distorts AHT; field definition is unclear (may be total session time).
decision: AHT calculated on non-abandoned contacts only; definition flagged as an open question for the data owner.

issue: Estimated_Cost is a derived field, not an observed cost
impact_on_conclusions: Cost = Handle_Seconds x $0.012 (+ $3.00 when Transferred) on every row (A9). It contains no channel-specific cost, so cost analysis only restates handle time and transfers.
decision: Used for directional cost-of-failure estimates only; stated as an assumption.

issue: Right-censored repeat-contact window (last 7 days of June)
impact_on_conclusions: Contacts on Jun 24-30 cannot be followed for 7 days, which would understate June repeat rate.
decision: Flag repeat_window_complete; repeat-rate denominators use complete-window contacts only.

issue: Targets table has no target for repeat contact, escalation, abandonment or AHT
impact_on_conclusions: Leadership is measured on 4 KPIs only; deterioration elsewhere is not visible against a target.
decision: Report these KPIs as trend-only and recommend targets be defined.
